goal: For real r>=0 and 0<h<=c, put a=(h+c)/(1+r), rp=r+a^-1 and rho=2c/(1+2c). Prove rp>0, 0<rp^-1<=2c, 0<rho<1 and, only if r>0, rp^-1<=rho*r^-1. This is the well-conditioned source variance update, retaining r=0 as initial A=infinity and establishing finite positive variance after the update.

truth_boundary: Only the deterministic well-conditioned parameter step of Lemma6.6(ii). The source condition-number test selects tau=c; it is not asserted by this lemma. c<1/4 is unnecessary for this scalar branch and explicitly generalized away. r^-1 represents a previous finite variance only under r>0. No finite-stage termination, implemented recursion, probability error, mixing or query cost.
